summary: Regression test of the Admin Detail View overhaul (P0) + Dealer Photo Upload (P1) — ALL BACKEND (22/22) and ALL 5 FRONTEND FLOWS PASS. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_dealer_photos.py with 22 tests covering (a) POST /api/admin/dealers/{id}/photos accepts full base64 profile_pic + cover_photo and both individually, empty string clears each field independently, empty body → 400, unknown dealer → 404; (b) GET /api/admin/dealers/{id} returns the full doc incl. photos; (c) GET /api/admin/dealers list includes photos when set; (d) POST /api/auth/login (dealer) response now includes profile_pic + cover_photo; (e) GET /api/auth/me returns them; (f) dealer JWT hitting the photo upload endpoint → 403, no JWT → 401; (g) full regression on /api/admin/submissions, /api/admin/billing?month=YYYY-MM, /api/vehicles/makes, /api/admin/dealers list, PATCH /api/admin/dealers/{id}, POST /api/admin/dealers/{id}/active, /archive + /restore, and POST /api/submissions → POST /api/admin/submissions/{id}/price. All pass in 2.87s. Frontend: seeded a fully-populated priced submission (FB-000016, id=6b8e449e-3c79-4489-8b28-2d6011ab238c, dealer seed_photo_488f91@example.com) with the new photo keys (front/driver_side/passenger_side/rear/interior), condition (8/9/7), Perfect windscreen, Full Service History with Agents, VIN, engine_number, last_service_date, service_mileage, and 2 reconditioning items, then priced at R549,000. Then via Playwright on mobile viewport 390x844 verified: (1) Hero 'OVERALL CONDITION 8.0/10' with EXT 8/10 · INT 9/10 · TYRES 7/10 pills + progress bar (avg computed correctly = (8+9+7)/3 = 8.0). (2) All new fields visible: Vehicle specs (fuel Petrol, transmission Automatic, year of production 2021, year registered 2021, mileage, colour), Condition section incl. Windscreen and Accident + Paint Evidence 'None/No' rows, Service History card, Reconditioning Estimate section, Identity card with VIN + engine number. (3) Tapping the FRONT thumbnail opens the PhotoCarousel with counter '1 / 5', label 'FRONT', dot indicator, close button (data-testid=photo-carousel-close) works. (4) DealerPhotosModal opens from /dealers via dealer-photos-{id} button — Cover Photo (16:9) + Profile Picture (1:1) sections + Upload/Cancel/Save Photos controls all render with the correct testIDs (dealer-cover-upload, dealer-profile-upload, dealer-photos-save, dealer-photos-close). (5) After admin sets photos via API for the seeded dealer, logging in as that dealer and opening /profile shows the round profile-avatar-img (data-testid=profile-avatar-img) overlapping the cover banner in WhatsApp Business style and NO upload controls are exposed (dealer-cover-upload / dealer-profile-upload are absent → read-only ✓). (6) Desktop cockpit 1440x900: PRICED bucket → FB-000016 opens with admin-avg-rating-hero, VEHICLE SPECS (6 chips), CONDITION (Exterior/Interior/Tyres/Windscreen/Accident/Paint Evidence), SERVICE HISTORY card, RECONDITIONING and IDENTITY sections all rendered. Tapping the first admin-photo-front thumbnail opens the PhotoCarousel; the next-chevron (data-testid=photo-carousel-next) is visible on desktop and cycling to slide 2 shows 'DRIVER\'S SIDE 2 / 5' + the prev-chevron appearing (correctly hidden at index 0, visible from index 1+). Monochrome theme confirmed on both mobile and desktop — only intentional pale-red (theme.colors.danger #FF4D6D) is used on destructive actions (Delete row button, Sign Out) which is consistent with 'danger red only on Yes' for Accident/Paint flags.

issues: The PhotoCarousel prev-arrow is only rendered from index >= 1 (photo-carousel-prev is null when on the first photo). This is a deliberate 'no wrap' UX choice — noting it in case the spec expected the prev button to always be visible and just be disabled at index 0.

Sign Out button uses colors.danger (#FF4D6D) — same pale red allowed for Accident/Paint 'Yes'. Consistent with theme but technically a chromatic element outside the Accident/Paint spec text. Low priority — same colour is theme-wide for destructive actions and matches iteration_10 baseline.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking: console still emits '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — same warning noted in iteration_10, not introduced by this iteration but still present in the new components.

action_items: Optional: consider always rendering photo-carousel-prev (disabled at index 0) for keyboard/screen-reader consistency — currently it is unmounted at index 0 and appears only from index 1+ on desktop.

Optional (cosmetic): the top-level 'VEHICLE SPECS' section heading is only rendered on the DESKTOP cockpit; on the mobile /vehicle/[id] screen the same six chips render immediately below the hero without an explicit 'VEHICLE SPECS' label. The data is present and fields all correct — flagging so the mobile layout can be aligned if desired.
Optional: migrate the remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow in the theme/components to clear the react-native-web deprecation warnings (carried over from iteration_10).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:280-282 — DealerPhotoUpload uses Optional[str] for both fields with `None` as the sentinel for 'do not touch' and `''` as the sentinel for 'clear'. server.py:822-825 correctly writes `updates[field] = payload.field or None`, converting `''` → None which is exactly what admin_get_dealer / login return (`.get()` yields None). Verified via unit tests.
server.py:807-830 photo upload endpoint correctly checks role=='dealer' and returns 404 on unknown ids. RBAC via Depends(require_admin) means dealer JWTs return 403 — verified.

server.py:336-350 /auth/login response payload now includes profile_pic + cover_photo. server.py:353-357 /auth/me returns the raw current dict, which get_current_user returns from db.users.find_one(projection={_id:0, password_hash:0}) — so photos flow through here too.

PhotoCarousel.tsx renders prev-chevron only when idx > 0 and next-chevron only when idx < photos.length-1 — this is a common UX pattern but means [data-testid=photo-carousel-prev] is null on the first slide. Testing agent unblocked this by clicking next then verifying prev appears.
vehicle/[id].tsx and WebAdminDashboard.tsx compute averageRating memoised from exterior_condition, interior_condition, tyre_condition — verified 8/9/7 → 8.0.
profile.tsx correctly gates the entire banner + avatar block on user.profile_pic + user.cover_photo. Renders read-only (no upload buttons) — verified.
DealerPhotosModal.tsx uses base64 data URLs and only POSTs the changed fields — matches backend contract that empty string clears and omitted keys are ignored.

rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Both P0 (admin detail view + hero + carousel) and P1 (dealer photo upload/display) features work end-to-end. The two test-script hiccups (SIGN IN button not findable via get_by_role, PRICED tab not findable via get_by_text) were selector issues in the test itself — resolved by using data-testids (login-submit-button, admin-filter-priced) — the underlying UI works fine.
